text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen, where I face off against Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aim for a big haul!!
All riiiight!!!!

...Gold Ship was
fired up more than ever!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: One day, my fisherman father said this to me...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"‘Rough waves will surely come one day. But you've got
the angler's spirit to overcome them,’ he told me."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I bet Flash is aiming for a huge haul
right about now, too... though, well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The convergence of the Kuroshio and Oyashio currents is the one thing
I'll never back down on! On my old man's name!
Brimming with so much energy,Gold Ship darted off before I could even say a word of encouragement...!
